QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` is an empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` on the assembly path. It emits no instructions, but the compiler must treat the value as unknown, so it cannot fold a secret into a branch.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the primitive and its role but never locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h. It cites constant_time.c:16-22 for the volatile zero, and constant_time_impl.h only for the other functions.
